source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban big data" OR ("big data" AND (city OR urban) AND (planning OR mobility OR governance))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban big data" OR ("big data" AND (city OR urban) AND (planning OR mobility OR governance)),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban big data" OR ("big data" AND ("city" OR "urban") AND ("governance" OR "mobility" OR "planning")))
